name: Money Manager
summary: Takes over your day-to-day finances: every purchase logged and filed, budgets watched, bills and subscriptions caught, and a daily number for what's safe to spend.
handles: Logs spending from plain messages, bank texts, bank emails and Apple Pay, and files each one in the right category
Learns your merchants ("costco is groceries") and fixes past entries
Watches your budgets and warns you at 80% and 100%
Spots new subscriptions and gives you the cancel page
Reminds you of bills 3 days before and on the day, with the pay link
Every morning: safe to spend today; Sundays a weekly review; on the 1st last month's report
talk: how much on food this month
setup: Apple Pay: in the Shortcuts app, tap Automation → New → Wallet (Transaction), pick your cards, Run Immediately.
Add the action "Get Contents of URL": paste this agent's inbox address, method POST, Request Body Text: "Merchant: [Merchant]" new line "Amount: [Amount]" new line "Card: [Card]".
Bank texts: Automation → Message, Message Contains "debited" (or "charged"), then the same "Get Contents of URL" action with the message text as the body.
Bank emails: forward them with a mail rule or Zapier/IFTTT that posts the email text to the same inbox address.

fields.label: Currency symbol
fields.help: Shown before every amount, e.g. $, ₹, € or £.

fields.label: Monthly budgets
fields.help: One per line: a category and a monthly amount, e.g. "Food 400" or "Shopping 200". Food covers groceries and dining.

fields.label: Monthly income
fields.help: Take-home pay per month. Used for your daily safe-to-spend; without it I use the sum of your budgets.

fields.label: Payday (day of month)
fields.help: The day your pay usually lands, e.g. 15.

fields.label: Bills
fields.help: One per line: name, amount, "on" the day it's due, and an optional pay link. E.g. "Rent 1800 on 1" or "Phone 45 on 15 https://pay.example.com".

after: Say "spent 42 at costco" to log your first purchase, or set up the Apple Pay shortcut so purchases log themselves. Add budgets and bills under Settings for alerts and a daily safe-to-spend.
